caption: Waiting for the perfect Monday to start? Here is why messy action beats a clean slate every time. An original FitLore story.
youtube_description:
Marcus spent 14 weeks waiting for the perfect Monday to start his fitness routine. Every minor hiccup pushed his goal to 'next week'—until an everyday lesson taught him that momentum doesn't wait for a clean slate.

This is an original illustrative FitLore story about overcoming the fresh start effect and perfectionist procrastination.

Source: Hengchen Dai, Katherine L. Milkman, and Jason Riis (2014), "The Fresh Start Effect: Temporal Landmarks Motivate Aspirational Behavior," Management Science. https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2014.1901

Stop waiting for Monday. Take the messy first step today.
